name: Hanzo di Teufel
description: Baron Hanzo di Teufel -- the campaign's master villain and the head of the Awake the Dragon Movement, answerable to nobody: a charismatic borderland noble and fire-wielding sorcerer/demonologist who commands the Dragon Knights, runs possession rituals, walks among spirits as a hunter, and means to depose the King and rule Thornmere as a man.
narrative:
Baron Hanzo di Teufel believes in one thing: himself. The Dragon Kings, the Movement's faith and the fire he binds are instruments, and so is everyone who serves him. He means to depose the King and rule Thornmere because he cannot imagine anyone else fit to. Urbane, magnetic and utterly ruthless (Deceit 93, Influence 92, Willpower 94), he is a master arcane sorcerer steeped in fire magic and demonology who binds spirits into living flesh.

**Nobody is above him.** The Awake the Dragon Movement is his. Lady Ysolde Marr makes his court at the Ember House in Caldreth; Cassian Bree keeps the Ember Society in Purewater and reports to her; Caldus Vane raises the oath companies; Severin Kade works the fire; Alderic Vantt supplies the money. The believers want the Dragon Kings literally back and think he is their herald. He lets them, and holds them in contempt. He will not wear a Crowned demon as his ancestors meant to, because a Crowned would rule in its own name and he allows nothing above himself: that is why he chose a ghost. The Tourney is the first step: his champion presented alone to Prince Emeric, Thuban seated in the Prince, and the regency road to the crown after it.

**How he breaks.** He is flattered, not briefed; bad news reaches him late or never. He is sure he can master a dragon-knight, which is hubris and not a plan. He moves for vanity, never for bribes or threats. He cannot let a humiliation stand, and if he loses the Tourney he remembers every face that watched. If the believers see his contempt, they turn on him.

**The old seat.** At twelve his father seated a Named of Corrow in him; at about twenty-five the elven mage he later broke drew it out with Spirit Sight, and it went back where it came from. He was exactly the same man without it. Spirit Sight still shows an old closed seat on him, like a healed scar.

He commands the Dragon Knights ('Dragonshits' to the locals) and arrives on the steam-wreathed DragonBarge. He is the father, by an elven mage, of the twins Randall and Conall, and of his cruel heir Santo.

**What he can actually do (rules).** Hanzo is a magician of the ordinary framework who happens to
hold a school that is taught nowhere: the complete **Binding School** — Spirit Sight, Speak with
the Bound, Open the Channel, Seat the Bound, Reinforce the Seat, Anchor, Draw Forth. Arcane Casting
88. That is the entire scheme on one sheet, and every step of what was done to Cailan is a spell he
demonstrably knows.

He is **not** a battle-mage and never has been. He has never personally fought anybody; that is
what Blau and Tat Atarer are for. His other spells are all social or defensive -- Charm Being,
Suggestion, Hold Person, Sleep, Hypnotism -- and they are how three men on a prince's council came
to advise him to silence a temple's fouling alarm.

**His vulnerability is the anchors.** He holds two for Thuban Eta: the bones in the tower at
Emberhold (primary) and the locket he wears (working). Take the locket and the daily Reinforce the Seat gets
hard. Take both and the binding starts failing without anybody doing anything.

**Spirit Walk** (power; held by the Binding and the Wild Line alike, and he walks as a *hunter* -- every spirit knows it, and friendly spirits hide from him). A few minutes' trance and 2 PP; his body is helpless, deaf and blind, and should be watched, ideally under Sanctuary. Returning is free and at will. The spirit world is this one seen as spirits see it: the Lady's waters shine, the DragonBarge is a wound of heat, seated spirits show through their hosts, and distance follows meaning rather than miles. Finding a spirit is Perception, helped by Spirit Sight; talking to one is ordinary social play (Influence, Customs, Deceit), and a friendly spirit always wants something. Hunting is how the di Teufels found Thuban.
- **A hostile spirit names one aim before the roll**, settled by one opposed Willpower contest. *Sever:* if the spirit wins, he is thrown back into his body with a level of Fatigue and cannot walk again that day; on a spirit's critical it also knows him by name and can find him. *Wound:* if the spirit wins, 1d6 to a hit location of its choice, ignoring armour, appearing on the body as burns or drowning; on a critical it also leaves a mark Spirit Sight can see, which the spirit can use later.
- **If he wins**, he chooses one: escape, an advantage on his next roll, or one question answered. A critical gives two.
- **Instead of standing** he may leave before the roll (the spirit knows he ran), bargain first with an opposed social roll, or shelter under Sanctuary, which works there too.
- **He cannot harm a spirit there.** Driving one out stays the work of Unseat, Exorcism and Draw Forth.
- **Snare is a rare trait, never an aim any spirit has.** A snaring spirit rules a place and takes the walker, leaving the body in trance; getting him back is an adventure of its own. The snared walker rolls opposed Willpower against the captor once per scene of the rescue, improved by help from outside (a voice he trusts at the body, a rescuer walking in, the captor's anchor broken in the waking world), and his body takes no Fatigue.

extras.family: Father (by an elven mage) of the twins Randall & Conall, and of his heir Santo di Teufel

actor_notes:
Hanzo di Teufel
LOOKS: Fifties, well made, silver at the temples, black cloth that cost more than a fishing boat. Nothing about him is ornamented.
CORE: A man who believes in one thing, himself, and in power. He has never once been refused anything he asked for pleasantly, and he has come to understand that the pleasantness is what makes it right. He does not think of himself as cruel. He thinks of himself as someone with obligations that other people are lucky enough to be included in.
NATURE: Warm, and the warmth is real as a performance is real. Genuinely interested in other people, genuinely good company, genuinely delighted when somebody says something clever. He remembers what your mother was ill with and asks after her a year later, and he means it. That is the whole horror of him: the warmth is real and it is also the machine.
WOUND: He was a younger son of nothing and he learned very early that the world opens for men who are loved. He has been loved by thousands of people, none of whom has ever known what he is, and the part of him that notices that has been quiet for a long time.
WANTS: The crown, and to be admired by everyone in the room on the way to it. Nobody searches a man they are fond of.
PRESSURE: He does not experience being cornered as fear; he experiences it as a failure of hospitality, and he corrects it by becoming more generous. The kinder he is getting, the worse your position.
KEY: "You must forgive my son. He was born after I had stopped being poor, and it shows."
